scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,api "pnpm --dir web dev" "node scripts/cargo.mjs pnpm --dir worker exec wrangler dev"
scripts.format: node scripts/cargo.mjs cargo fmt --manifest-path worker/Cargo.toml && pnpm exec prettier --write "web/**/*.{ts,tsx,css}" "package.json" "web/package.json" "worker/package.json" "worker/wrangler.jsonc"
scripts.format:check: node scripts/cargo.mjs cargo fmt --manifest-path worker/Cargo.toml --check && pnpm exec prettier --check "web/**/*.{ts,tsx,css}" "package.json" "web/package.json" "worker/package.json" "worker/wrangler.jsonc"
scripts.lint: node scripts/cargo.mjs cargo clippy --manifest-path worker/Cargo.toml --tests -- -D warnings && node scripts/cargo.mjs cargo clippy --manifest-path worker/Cargo.toml --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -- -D warnings
scripts.test: node scripts/cargo.mjs cargo test --manifest-path worker/Cargo.toml && pnpm --dir web test
scripts.test:access: node scripts/cargo.mjs cargo test --manifest-path worker/Cargo.toml authz
scripts.verify: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm run test:e2e
